issues.description: Function parameter mismatch for simulate_msd_two_rounds: the problem statement (and the reference solution) declare simulate_msd_two_rounds(n_shots: int, p: float, batch_size: int = 1000000) -> tuple[float, float], but the template implementation declares simulate_msd_two_rounds(n_shots: int, p: float) -> tuple[float, float] (no batch_size parameter). The template docstring even documents a batch_size parameter while the signature omits it. This inconsistency forces students to reconcile conflicting APIs, can break tests or example calls that expect batch_size, and makes the intended function contract unclear.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template function signature to match the problem statement and solution by adding the batch_size parameter with the same default: def simulate_msd_two_rounds(n_shots: int, p: float, batch_size: int = 1000000) -> tuple[float, float]:. Also ensure the template docstring documents the parameter consistently and update any internal mentions so students see a unified API.

issues.description: Function signature mismatch for the two-round simulation routine: the problem statement and the solution expect a simulate_msd_two_rounds function that accepts a batch_size parameter (simulate_msd_two_rounds(n_shots: int, p: float, batch_size: int = 1000000) -> tuple[float, float]) but the template repository provides a stub with the signature simulate_msd_two_rounds(n_shots: int, p: float) -> tuple[float, float] (no batch_size). Concept: simulating two rounds of MSD in batches. Problem statement name and parameters: simulate_msd_two_rounds(n_shots:int, p: float, batch_size:int = 1000000). Template stub name and parameters: simulate_msd_two_rounds(n_shots:int, p: float) (missing batch_size). Solution implementation name and parameters: simulate_msd_two_rounds(n_shots: int, p: float, batch_size: int = 1000000). This discrepancy forces students to either change the template signature themselves or to implement batching behavior differently than described, adding friction and potential grading mismatches.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template stub to match the problem statement and solution signature by changing the function definition in template_repository/msd.py to: def simulate_msd_two_rounds(n_shots: int, p: float, batch_size: int = 1000000) -> tuple[float, float]: and ensure the docstring documents the batch_size parameter. This preserves the intended exercise (batched simulation) and removes a source of student confusion. Alternatively, if batching was not intended, update the problem statement to remove the batch_size parameter and adjust the solution accordingly.
